title: UPI MDR on hold as UPI hits 25.47 billion
takeaways: 25.47 billion UPI payments in October 2026, a record.
₹1,01,707 crore a day: first month above ₹1 lakh crore.
Only around 4% of merchant transactions would be charged.
Rollout deferred past Diwali; no new date yet.
source_note: Sources: NPCI via Entrepreneur India, Outlook Money; ThePrint (PTI); FPJ; Punjab Kesari (IANS)
